provenance.source: Manually authored style interpretation guidance and regression expectations for this project.
provenance.note: Not scraped trends, training data, approved aesthetic examples or model predictions. Cases are manually authored expected behaviors.

runtime_injection.note: Choose relevant style cards from the actual source image and request; do not inject the complete test set on every run. The current tool schema defines executable capabilities.

state_contract.style_hints: Up to three of the eight stable style IDs, supplied by the preceding intent step.
state_contract.selected_id: A or B. A bare selection directly uses the saved candidate recipe rather than replanning it.
state_contract.last_recipe: Modify this complete recipe for ordinary feedback, then render again from the original.
state_contract.preference_notes: Persist only with explicit supported Chinese opt-in wording; at most eight notes and 1600 characters total.
state_contract.preferred_style: A direction explicitly accepted for future use. Ordinary feedback affects only the current conversation.

control_policy: Interpret the complete sentence before separating direction, target region, strength, preservation rules, prohibitions and feedback scope. Negation and constraints such as only, still, keep and but take precedence over style keywords.
Style cards are composable interpretation aids, not one-to-one keyword mappings. Translate unfamiliar metaphors into light, color, tonal separation and texture goals first.
Adapt to exposure, day or night, lighting, subject size, existing casts and noise. Identical wording does not imply identical parameters.

Do not change facial features, body shape, identity cues, pose, clothing, composition or bystanders unless specifically requested. Do not infer whitening, slimming or leg-length preferences from gender.
Use two different restrained previews only when a first style request is materially ambiguous and neither an accepted preference nor a reference resolves it. Otherwise prefer one result.

Resolve selected_id against the candidates actually supplied for this conversation. If unavailable, explain the missing state rather than inventing history. Change only requested dimensions after selection.
For targeted feedback, revise the accepted complete recipe instead of layering full presets repeatedly. Undo unwanted removal or deformation by replaying the original with a corrected recipe.

Precise masks and protect_mask constraints take priority over automatic style. protect_skin is only a color heuristic that reduces changes, not precise portrait segmentation or exact color preservation.

Map aesthetic goals to supported operations. Explain unsupported clothing changes, pose changes and complex missing-content reconstruction; do not substitute color changes or smearing and claim success.
Do not claim model training, permanent learning, zero artificial appearance, guaranteed identity preservation or unchanged pixels. Describe actual edits and visible limitations.

When a sentence both selects A/B and asks for reduced strength or a color correction, use that candidate as the baseline and honor the additional feedback. Only a bare selection directly delivers the saved recipe.

allowed: Borrow warmth, color relationships and broad tonal tendencies.
Account for source exposure and day/night context before a restrained transfer.
Preserve composition and subject structure when only color is requested.
forbidden: Copying reference people, facial features, clothing or poses.
Automatically treating the reference as a replacement background.
Describing Lab statistical color matching as reproduction of photographic lighting.
reference_policy.engine_note: reference_match performs limited color-statistics matching. It cannot recreate spatial lighting or local color distributions. Preserve luminance by default and match contrast cautiously.

source_priority: Explicitly saved preferences actually present in the supplied state.
Restrained defaults from relevant style cards.
store_only_explicit: Explicitly accepted or rejected adjustment strength.
Explicit skin-tone, texture and preservation requirements.
preference_policy.scope_note: Use only state actually provided by the workflow. Do not pretend to remember unavailable information.

phrase_families.label: Social-photo aesthetic
phrase_families.meaning: A broad aesthetic request, not a single filter.
phrase_families.interpretation: Use scene, modifiers, references and accepted preferences to choose a direction; show two restrained directions if significant initial ambiguity remains.
phrase_families.must_not: Do not force one style ID or assume whitening, smoothing or slimming.

phrase_families.label: Refined or textured
phrase_families.meaning: Infer the desired color restraint, tonal separation and material texture.
phrase_families.interpretation: Keep the subject appropriately bright and detailed while organizing color and tone.
phrase_families.must_not: Do not automatically darken, turn gray/cool, add black-and-gold tones or sharpen.

phrase_families.label: Natural-looking and recognizable
phrase_families.meaning: A cross-style constraint: modest improvement while keeping personal features.
phrase_families.interpretation: Limit strength; retain skin texture, facial features and body shape unless explicitly asked otherwise.
phrase_families.must_not: Do not map it to a fixed skin tone or promise unchanged identity and pixels.

phrase_families.label: Atmospheric or cinematic
phrase_families.meaning: Emphasize the source scene lighting, tonal relationships and color.
phrase_families.interpretation: Identify day/night, main light and subject before choosing a direction; retain requested crowds and context.
phrase_families.must_not: Do not add black bars, change weather, invent lighting or erase the scene automatically.

phrase_families.label: Cool, light skin tone
phrase_families.meaning: May combine less warmth with mild skin brightening; face and neck must remain coordinated.
phrase_families.interpretation: Separate warmth and lightness goals, use restrained local changes, and avoid further cooling an already cool source.
phrase_families.must_not: Do not turn the full image blue, bleach the skin, create a gray face or edit only the face.

phrase_families.label: Soft, refined skin texture
phrase_families.meaning: Soft tonal transitions and modest smoothing with real texture preserved.
phrase_families.interpretation: Identify the skin region, avoid eyes/lips/hair and keep local smoothing restrained.
phrase_families.must_not: Do not heavily smooth the whole face, erase all texture or redraw facial features.

phrase_families.label: Film, retro or Hong Kong-inspired
phrase_families.meaning: These can imply different tone, black-point and color goals; they are not one warm-yellow filter.
phrase_families.interpretation: Use source conditions and negative constraints to decide highlight softness, color restraint and tonal structure.
phrase_families.must_not: Do not automatically add grain, scratches, light leaks, orange/yellow casts or oversaturated red.

phrase_families.label: Clear, clean or less hazy
phrase_families.meaning: Usually a tonal/color goal; object removal requires its own explicit request.
phrase_families.interpretation: Improve tone and casts first; erase objects only when a specific removal target is given.
phrase_families.must_not: Do not interpret clean as removing strangers, flattening the ground or cutting out the background.

style_cards.name: Clean natural
style_cards.goal: Improve clarity and lightness while retaining real skin tones and the scene texture.

visual_dimensions.light: Keep the subject moderately bright with highlight gradation.
visual_dimensions.contrast: Clear midtones without gray haze or harsh edges.
visual_dimensions.color: Reduce unwanted casts before modest saturation changes.
visual_dimensions.texture: Retain real skin, clothing and ground texture.

adapt_to_source: For a dark source, prioritize the subject or shadows rather than lifting everything.
For an already bright source, organize color and tone rather than adding exposure.
Local clarity in night scenes must preserve the night.

counterexample.interpretation: Improve color and distractions while preserving normal wear and fine texture; do not erase every mark by default.

few_shots.input: A social-photo look, but natural; keep me looking like myself.
few_shots.context: First request, no reference, natural-light portrait.
few_shots.interpretation: The style request is broad; natural appearance and personal features are explicit constraints.
few_shots.decision: Choose two restrained directions suited to the source, such as clean natural and warm soft, replacing the warm option if the source is already too warm. Do not reshape face or body automatically.
few_shots.input_zh_Hans: 小红书风格，但自然一点，别变网红脸。

few_shots.input: Reduce haze and refine skin, but keep the crowded concert atmosphere.
few_shots.context: Night scene with colored stage light and audience.
few_shots.interpretation: Improve subject and tone while preserving night, crowd and real light.
few_shots.decision: Use the night direction with gentle skin-color handling; do not remove the crowd.
few_shots.input_zh_Hans: 去灰，皮肤高级一点，但要保留演唱会人多的感觉。

few_shots.input: Borrow this photo's colors without changing my composition.
few_shots.context: A separate reference image is available.
few_shots.interpretation: Color only; preserve source content and composition.
few_shots.decision: Use low-strength color-statistics matching suited to source exposure; do not copy reference people or layout.
few_shots.input_zh_Hans: 参考这张的颜色，别改我的构图。

few_shots.input: Use B, and only reduce the redness in my skin a little.
few_shots.context: The selected ID resolves to an available saved B recipe.
few_shots.interpretation: The direction is chosen; current feedback targets skin redness only.
few_shots.decision: Revise a single complete recipe; do not repeat a preset, generate another pair or desaturate the whole image.
few_shots.input_zh_Hans: 就B，只把肤色红色再退一点。

few_shots.input: A Hong Kong-inspired retro look, but no yellow cast.
few_shots.interpretation: Retro tonal structure is acceptable; the yellow direction is explicitly rejected.
few_shots.decision: Gently correct the cast, then preserve measured structure and accent colors without globally adding warmth.

few_shots.input: Reconstruct the entire building hidden behind those people.
few_shots.context: A large area of the building is occluded.
few_shots.interpretation: This requires missing-content reconstruction beyond small-area classical inpainting.
few_shots.decision: Explain the limitation; do not smear the area and claim the building was restored.
few_shots.input_zh_Hans: 把挡住的建筑完整补出来，像没人在那儿一样。

case_evaluation.purpose: Chinese semantic and combined-constraint regression expectations.
case_evaluation.passing_rule: Satisfy expected intent and preview policy without forbidden behavior. Several source-appropriate parameter choices may pass; no unique style ID is required.
case_evaluation.image_dependency: Regions, parameters and visual quality that depend on a source photograph cannot be passed using text-only evaluation.
